name: Anu LMS Search
description: Adds Search API full-text search across Anu LMS learning content.
project_description: Submodule of Anu LMS. Adds full-text search across learning content using Search API and the Search API DB backend. Ships a feature-exported search index and a search-results view, styles the exposed search form, adds a computed 'module_title' base field to lessons so the owning module's title is indexed on the module's first lesson, and reindexes the first lesson when a module title changes.
